links.outcome: LLM vs structured phenotype diagnostic performance for OUD against physician chart review
links.effect: Structured phenotype sensitivity 0.84, specificity 0.964, PPV 0.58; LLM sensitivity 0.81, specificity 0.996, PPV 0.92; LLM specificity significantly higher (p<0.0001).
links.quote: Although the structured phenotype showed slightly higher sensitivity, the LLM achieved higher specificity and PPV, suggesting potential to reduce false-positive alerts in ED workflows.

screen.reason: Retrospective study comparing the diagnostic accuracy of an LLM against an operational structured phenotype CDS trigger using EHR notes, without testing a deployment practice or workflow safeguard.
